<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Pagină-1" id="vWR3Y8U4rHYtrny4ng1T"> <mxGraphModel dx="2049" dy="1152" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml UC1_Search
 left to right direction
 skinparam packageStyle rectangle
 skinparam actorStyle awesome

 actor Guest
 actor Owner
 Guest <|-- Owner

 rectangle \"DogApp – 1. Search\" {
 usecase \"Register\n(email + password + consent)\" as UC_Register
 usecase \"Verify email\" as UC_Verify
 usecase \"Log in\" as UC_Login

 usecase \"Set location\" as UC_SetLocation
 usecase \"Generate approximate\nlocation\" as UC_Approx

 usecase \"Search dogs nearby\" as UC_Search
 usecase \"Set search radius\" as UC_Radius
 usecase \"Filter by breed\n(incl. Mixed breed)\" as UC_Breed
 usecase \"Filter by size / age /\ntemperament / neutered\" as UC_Filters
 usecase \"Exclude blocked users\" as UC_ExcludeBlocked

 usecase \"View results\n(list / map)\" as UC_Results
 usecase \"View dog profile\" as UC_DogProfile
 usecase \"View breed info\" as UC_BreedInfo

 usecase \"Send message\n(→ 2. Social)\" as UC_Message
 usecase \"Invite to playdate\n(→ 3. Events)\" as UC_Invite
 usecase \"Block owner\" as UC_Block
 usecase \"Report owner\" as UC_Report
 }

 Guest --> UC_Register
 Guest --> UC_Login
 UC_Register ..> UC_Verify : <<include>>

 Owner --> UC_SetLocation
 Owner --> UC_Search
 Owner --> UC_DogProfile

 UC_SetLocation ..> UC_Approx : <<include>>
 UC_Search ..> UC_Login : <<include>>
 UC_Search ..> UC_SetLocation : <<include>>
 UC_Search ..> UC_Radius : <<include>>
 UC_Search ..> UC_ExcludeBlocked : <<include>>
 UC_Search ..> UC_Results : <<include>>
 UC_Breed ..> UC_Search : <<extend>>
 UC_Filters ..> UC_Search : <<extend>>

 UC_DogProfile ..> UC_Results : <<extend>>
 UC_BreedInfo ..> UC_DogProfile : <<extend>>
 UC_Message ..> UC_DogProfile : <<extend>>
 UC_Invite ..> UC_DogProfile : <<extend>>
 UC_Block ..> UC_DogProfile : <<extend>>
 UC_Report ..> UC_DogProfile : <<extend>>

 note right of UC_Approx
 Random point at 300 m – 1 km,
 generated ONCE at signup /
 address change. Exact
 coordinates are never stored.
 end note

 note right of UC_ExcludeBlocked
 Hidden in both directions:
 users I blocked and users
 who blocked me.
 end note
 @enduml",
 "config": null
